findings.summary: The collision limit can overwrite an existing `_999.md` file.
findings.mechanism: When the base filename and every suffix through `_999.md` already exist, the loop exits because `counter < 1000` becomes false while `out_path` still names the existing `_999.md`; `write_text` then replaces that file.

findings.summary: The script-tag escape is case-sensitive even though HTML end tags are case-insensitive.
findings.mechanism: A graph value containing `</ScRiPt>` is left unchanged by `replace("</", "<\\/")`; the HTML parser still closes the inline script and parses following attacker-controlled markup.
